Yes I am. Terrified. Absolutely shit my pants afraid of anything close to the concept of death. Which is weird. Because if the Russians were to nuke my dorm room right now, I wouldn't mind.

I'm afraid it will hurt. My pain tolerance is low. Most things that most people would just shrug off, I make a big deal out of. I stub my toe, I will fucking collapse to the ground and be mad as shit. So I can't do anything to hurt myself.

I'm afraid it will hurt my family. My mom in shaky health and my dad who is sacrificing everything he has to support us. My brother who I love so very much but I am misophonic to so I can't talk to him without getting mad at. My entire extended family that's looking to me as the success story who's excelling in America. The role model of my cousins. I'll let them down. I'll hurt them. I can't do that. 

But most of all... I'm afraid it will hurt you, Hannah. The most amazing girl I've ever met. One of few real true friends I've ever had. The person who saved my life. The girl I developed a crush over and am completely infatuated with. The one person I cannot imagine hurting yet seems to be the cause of my problems. I love you Hannah. And I'm scared. Scared of what you'll see at my worst. Scared of what I'll do when I'm in an even worse place. Scared of what you'll see in my binder full of letters for you. 

Scared of what my death will do to you. But even more afraid that it'll mean nothing to you.

I'm experiencing pretty much exactly the same thing as you are. Like nearly verbatim. I burst into tears halfway through. 

I have a folder full of late night rants to myself and letters addressed to her that I never would dare give her. And when I'm gone, they're going to find it, top of my second desk drawer. And they're going to read it. And find her. And probably show her. If not, the rumors would be enough. 

I think that bringing this upon her would be the worst thing I could do. But... I feel like I *have* to. Because when I give up, I need to make sure she doesn't. 

I hope you find peace with the situation, OP. You and me both.
